summary.zh: 把书或文档整理成可查阅的知识库
summary.en: Compile a book or docs folder into a skill knowledge base.

description.zh: 把一本书、一套文档或规格集整理成结构化的知识库，含章节摘要、术语表和速查表，便于按需查阅而不是整本重读。支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、HTML 和 Markdown 输入，处理受版权保护的材料前会先做授权检查。
description.en: Turns a book or docs folder into a knowledge base with chapter summaries, a glossary and a cheatsheet, built for lookup rather than rereading. Accepts PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML and Markdown; copyrighted material passes a rights check first.
